import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static char[][] g = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] n_scientists = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] n_rescue = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] infect_time = new int[N][N];
    static int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] reach_time = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static final int FLOW_N = 2 * N * N + 2;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
    static int[][] c;
    static int[][] f;
    static int[] adj_ptr;
    static int[] d;
    static int[] p;

    static boolean make_level_graph(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (c[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && d[v] == -1) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != -1;
    }

    static boolean dfs(int u, int t) {
        if (u == t) return true;
        for (int i = adj_ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = adj[u].get(i);
            if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && c[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && dfs(v, t)) {
                p[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
            adj_ptr[u]++;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean find_aug_path(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(p, -1);
        p[s] = 0;
        return dfs(s, t);
    }

    static void init_flow() {
        for (int[] row : c) Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        for (int[] row : f) Arrays.fill(row, 0);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        adj[u].add(v);
        adj[v].add(u);
        c[u][v] += capacity;
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int max_flow_value = 0;
        while (make_level_graph(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(adj_ptr, 0);
            while (find_aug_path(s, t)) {
                int b = INF;
                for (int v = t, u = p[v]; v != s; v = u, u = p[v]) {
                    b = Math.min(b, c[u][v] - f[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t, u = p[v]; v != s; v = u, u = p[v]) {
                    f[u][v] += b;
                    f[v][u] -= b;
                }
                max_flow_value += b;
            }
        }
        return max_flow_value;
    }

    static int node(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        int[] explode = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    g[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    g[i][j] = 'Z';
                    explode[0] = i;
                    explode[1] = j;
                } else {
                    g[i][j] = '.';
                    n_scientists[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    n_rescue[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int[] row : infect_time) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        infect_time[explode[0]][explode[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{explode[0], explode[1]});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = i + di[d], nj = j + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && g[ni][nj] == '.' && infect_time[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    infect_time[ni][nj] = infect_time[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int[][][] arr3 : reach_time) for (int[][] arr2 : arr3) for (int[] arr1 : arr2) Arrays.fill(arr1, -1);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] == '.') {
                    reach_time[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                    q2.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cur = q2.poll();
                        int ii = cur[0], jj = cur[1];
                        if (infect_time[ii][jj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] < infect_time[ii][jj]) {
                            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                                int ni = ii + di[d], nj = jj + dj[d];
                                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && g[ni][nj] == '.'
                                        && (infect_time[ni][nj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= infect_time[ni][nj])
                                        && reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                    reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] = reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                    q2.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        int size = 2 * n * n + 2;
        adj = new ArrayList[size];
        for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) adj[k] = new ArrayList<>();
        c = new int[size][size];
        f = new int[size][size];
        adj_ptr = new int[size];
        d = new int[size];
        p = new int[size];

        init_flow();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (n_scientists[i][j] != 0) {
                    add_edge(src, node(n, i, j, false), n_scientists[i][j]);
                }
                if (n_rescue[i][j] != 0) {
                    add_edge(node(n, i, j, true), sink, n_rescue[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                        if (reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] >= 0 && reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            add_edge(node(n, i, j, false), node(n, ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow(src, sink));
    }
}
